stem.text: Methyl isocyanate, $\text{CH}_3\text{NCO}$, is a toxic liquid which is used in the manufacture of some pesticides.
What is the approximate angle between the bonds formed by the N atom in a molecule of methyl isocyanate?

A.alt: Displayed formula H3C–N=C=O with the angle at N labelled 104°.

B.alt: Displayed formula H3C–N=C=O with the angle at N labelled 109°.

C.alt: Displayed formula H3C–N=C=O with the angle at N labelled 120°.

D.alt: Displayed formula H3C–N=C=O drawn linear with the angle at N labelled 180°.
